subject: Saturday mix-up
text: Hi, I think I made a mess of my weekend already because I read the calendar backwards, or maybe the invite popped up at midnight when my brain was off, but I was fully expecting Saturday morning hiking with neighbors and apparently the event is Sunday noon, which is awkward because I already promised to fix the shed at nine and maybe water the plant too. I could still squeeze the trail in if I leave later, unless the shed turns into its usual endless thing, so I am probably not going to make sense until I nap.
